_comment: Stage 2.2 M-OPD: task-routed specialist teachers (push_box and open_room_door Stage 2.1 specialists on the Stage 1.1 teacher; every other task is taught by the plain teacher) distilled into the OPSD S300 EMA student for 300 streaming updates (eta = 0.5). Order: (1) build the OPSD teacher cache (configs/stage1_2_opsd/teacher_cache.json); (2) `python -m wam_policy.mopd cache --config this --previous-cache <OPSD cache> --output <dir>` collects only the expert tasks with their specialists and merges them into <dir>/cache; (3) `python -m wam_policy.mopd train` with MOPD_TEACHER_CACHE=<dir>/cache. render_mode sampled renders only the frames the policy receives (identical frames, faster simulation).
